Note Type: ED Triage / Nursing Note

Date: 2026-05-08

Chief Complaint: "My belly hurts and I keep throwing up."

HPI: Patient arrived via private vehicle. Reports onset two days ago,

No diarrhea. Last oral intake: clear liquids 4 hours ago.

Allergies: NKDA.

Medications: Reports taking lisinopril and omeprazole at home.

Physical Exam: Awake, alert, oriented x3. Holds abdomen, antalgic gait

Plan: Triaged ESI level 3, IV access established, labs drawn, MD aware.
